Class GamepadDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a gamepad input device, providing access to gamepad buttons and axes, state tracking, calibration, and utility methods for gamepad input.

public sealed class GamepadDevice : InputDevice, IComparable<InputDevice>

Remarks

Joystick axes report values in the range [-1.0, 1.0]:

  • X axis: -1.0 is left, 1.0 is right
  • Y axis: -1.0 is up, 1.0 is down
Trigger axes report values in the range [0, 1.0]:
  • 0 means not pressed
  • 0.5 is half pressed
  • 1.0 is fully pressed
This depends on the gamepad and its configuration!

DeviceProcessPriority

The process priority of this gamepad device instance.

Change this value to change the order in which this device is processed in InputSystem. Lower priorities are processed first. 

public uint DeviceProcessPriority

Field Value

uint

Remarks

A unique value based on the order of instantiation is assigned per default.

GetAxisRange(ShapeGamepadJoyAxis)

Gets the currently used range (minimum and maximum) for the specified joystick axis. Returns null if no range has been recorded for the axis.

public ValueRange? GetAxisRange(ShapeGamepadJoyAxis axis)

Parameters

axis ShapeGamepadJoyAxis

Returns

ValueRange?

Remarks

Axis ranges are updated whenever the axis is used. Therefore, the current reported range may not be the absolute minimum and maximum of the axis, just the minimum and maximum range used until now.
